name: earth-smart
description: All-in-one mega platform for design, building, social networking, news, tools, and learning
author: Suman Suryabanshi

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:backend
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
